title: Comparing and learning figures of merit for quantum circuit compilation
summary: To make quantum algorithms executable on a particular quantum device, they need to be compiled into circuits that respect constraints of the quantum hardware. This compilation usually involves multiple steps, where many hardware-compatible circuits are generated, and the best circuit is selected. To say which circuit is best, the quality of a circuit is generally quantified by a $\textit{figure of merit}$ (FoM).
